notes.title: Our biggest update yet and a new wave of playtesting!
notes.notes:
You can participate in the playtest in our [url=https://discord.com/invite/fMCFMaZj3t]Discord community![/url] Welcome!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741435/c32725c5f990a79d8d98ff19ba59a17e50ff789d.png[/img]

[h1]Ammossum v.0.7 — The biggest Demo Update[/h1]

[b]What's New:[/b]
We’ve reworked a ton of systems in Ammossum!
And the best part? It’s all thanks to your feedback — seriously, thank you!
Here are some of the biggest changes now live in the game:
[list]
[*] Free aim! You can now shoot in any direction
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44741435/cb544775e610068d8730d1773358262fbedb53a9.gif[/img]
[*] No more materials. We’ve simplified weapon crafting. Now you can just break down items into bones 
[*] Battle rewards! After every fight, you’ll get to choose your reward
[*] And much more!
[/list]


The update is already available in the new demo. You can play it through our Discord server! 
See you!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.36!
notes.notes:
[h1]Ammossum v.0.36 — Bug Fixes & New Aiming Feature[/h1]

[b]What's New:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved shooting mechanics
[*] Fixed top UI panel display in combat
[*] Corrected bone collection stats post-battle
[*] All remaining bones at battle's end now counted as collected
[*] Combo scale display fixed
[*] Added indicators for food bonus acquisition
[*] Bow and slingshot modified, multishot removed
[*] Fixed cactus booze not working in boss fights
[*] Boss now has an HP bar and is humorously named "BOSS"
[*] Bullet-type projectiles fixed: sub-projectiles now spawn from defeated enemies as described, and ricochet functions as intended
[*] Fixed issue with frogs jumping continuously without delay
[*] Armadillos now vulnerable to piercing arrows
[*] Scoring for runs adjusted: no points for weapon level or items within upon defeat
[*] UI fixes for text overflow in certain windows
[*] Enhanced visual effects for many items
[*] Balance adjustments
[/list]

The update is already available in the new demo — play and share your feedback. It will really help us with the next update!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3!
notes.notes:

[b]What's New:[/b]
[list]
[*] 9 New Combo Drinks Added:

[list]
[*] Boss' Gin
[*] Bombeer
[*] Cactus Booze
[*] Сapybeer
[*] Railtripy
[*] Three Little Mushrooms

[*] New Railcar Added: The Poacher.
[*] Ammossum Stats Added: Ammossum now has stats that can be upgraded during runs using food and drinks.
[*] General Game Rebalance.
[*] UI and UX Improvements.
[*] Bug Fixes from the Previous Version.
[/list]

The update is already available in the new demo — play and share your feedback. It will really help us with the next update!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.25!
notes.notes:
[h1]Ammossum v.0.25 — Second Big Update[/h1]

[b]What's New:[/b]
[list]
[*] Item card info: now shows stats, levels, upgrade, and transformation details
[*] Global physics changes: updated projectiles, obstacles, and enemies
[*] Melee combat reworked
[*]  Changes to some Items:
- Bow, Slingshot: multishot — a fully charged shot now fires three arrows
- Club, Mace: every N hit is stronger.
- Rattle: bullet spread occurs at the moment of explosion, not with each bounce
[*] Visual effect improvements: updated old effects and added new ones
[*] Balance adjustments
[/list]
Temporary changes: some items and one combo card are being reworked and are temporarily unavailable in this version. They'll be back soon!

The update is already available in the new demo — play and share your feedback. It will really help us with the next update!

notes.title: Red Frog update demo 0.2!
notes.notes:
[h1]We just released a new update for the demo, here are the patchnotes:[/h1]

[b]Gameplay:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Feature: Combo! Items are no longer given randomly during battles. Now, you need to fill the combo meter by defeating enough enemies within a short time. Once the meter is full, the player receives a bonus based on the hired railcars
[*] New Feature: Ticket System
[*] New Enemy: Red Frog
[*] Rebalance: Some items and railcars have been temporarily removed for polishing
[*] Polishing: Improved mechanics for arrows and fragments
[/list]

[b]UI:[/b]
[list]
[*] Main Menu Screen
[*] End Game Stats Screen
[*] Welcome Screen
[*] Inventory Screen: Minor polishing
[/list]

[b]Localization:[/b]

[/list]
